title: What's new in Shopify Connector: Overview (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Item and product synchronization - tariff codes
Shop card settings - tariff mapping and barcode search
B2B catalog issues and market-based catalogs
Company location tax registration and localization extensions
Order synchronization and number series configuration
Multi-line order handling and returns processing
Return orders, exchange processing, and negative line handling
Tax details, area code mapping, and closing remarks

features.name: Tariff code synchronization
features.description: Import and export tariff codes (harmonized system codes) from items in Business Central to Shopify products. Tariff codes are mapped but not auto-created; they must exist in the tariff list to import.
caveats: Tariff codes are not auto-created; they must already exist in Business Central's tariff list
If tariff codes are not present, they are ignored during import

features.name: Find mapping by barcode
features.description: New field in shop card settings that controls whether the connector searches by barcode in item references when SKU mapping fails. Can be disabled to prevent undesired multiple-to-one variant mapping.
caveats: Field is hidden by default and requires personalization to display
When enabled, can cause multiple variants to map to the same Business Central entity if barcode matching occurs
Manual mapping required if disabled

features.name: Unlisted product status
features.description: Support for Shopify's new 'unlisted' status where products exist in Shopify and can be sold via direct link, but are not visible in the online store.

features.name: Skipped records tracking
features.description: Visibility into items skipped during price synchronization. Skipped records page and Role Center widget now show which items were not synchronized (e.g., sales-blocked items) and any API errors.
caveats: Job queue still marks runs as successful even when items are skipped
Blocked items (e.g., sales-blocked) cannot have prices calculated and will be skipped

features.name: Provide feedback mechanism
features.description: New 'Provide feedback' button in Shopify shop card that sends detailed feedback (text, screenshots, files) to Microsoft Development Center team privately, separate from Shopify App Store reviews.
caveats: Feedback is private and not visible on Shopify App Store
User can opt to be contacted back about the feedback

features.name: B2B company synchronization
features.description: Company synchronization now visible by default for all Shopify plans. Companies can be added to Shopify with automatic creation of customer and catalog for B2B.
caveats: Not every B2B capability is available on all Shopify plans; auto-create B2B catalog only available for Plus and Advanced plans

features.name: Market-based catalogs
features.description: Use Shopify markets (by region, B2B, or POS) linked to Business Central catalogs instead of company-location-based catalogs. Provides easier management and prevents duplicate price synchronization issues.
caveats: Market catalogs are recommended over company-location catalogs to avoid confusion
Company-location option only available for Plus customers
Multiple B2B catalogs linked to same Shopify catalog will cause last sync to overwrite previous prices

features.name: Company location tax registration import
features.description: Tax registration IDs for company locations are imported from Shopify and used when mapping Shopify companies to Business Central companies.

features.name: Shopify Connector localization extensions - Belgium and US
features.description: New small localization extensions released for Belgium and US outside AppSource. Belgium extension adds 'enterprise number' option for company tax ID mapping (replacing VAT registration ID). US extension adds country-specific capability.
caveats: Extensions not found in AppSource; distributed differently
Belgium extension required because local field for enterprise number not supported in W1 version
VAT registration ID field mapping previously failed in Belgium

features.name: Shopify order number in sales documents
features.description: Ability to populate Shopify order number as a separate field in sales documents or as an extra line. Can be toggled via a new use Shopify order number setting.
caveats: requires that invoice and sales order documents support manual numbers
setting inherited from setup at order import time

features.name: Contact numbers on sales orders
features.description: Ability to populate sell-to, bill-to, and ship-to contact numbers on sales orders from Shopify orders. Contacts are populated automatically and can be changed if multiple contacts exist.
caveats: requires personalization of order page to display

features.name: Multi-line order handling and returns
features.description: Support for Shopify orders with exchanges and returns that result in multiple lines in Business Central sales documents. Includes handling of returned items and store credits.

features.name: Return order processing from Shopify refunds
features.description: Process Shopify refunds as Business Central return orders instead of credit memos. Includes two-line handling with positive and negative quantities.
caveats: credit memos not compatible with directed put-away and pick in advanced warehouse
return order option available as alternative

features.name: Move negative lines in return orders
features.description: Standard Business Central action to move negative lines from a return order to a separate sales order or invoice. Default value is order for return orders and invoice for credit memos.
caveats: document must be reopened before applying the action

features.name: Tax details on Shopify refunds and orders
features.description: Display of tax fact box and tax lines on Shopify refunds and related orders. Includes tax area code and tax liable fields that can be overridden before creating sales documents.
caveats: described as pre-release; fact box position will change in final version

features.name: Tax area code and tax liable mapping override
features.description: New fields on Shopify order details (tax area code and tax liable) that can be manually overridden. When overridden, standard tax mapping is not triggered during document creation.
caveats: preview status indicated by presenter noting this is a separate video topic
